title: English - Rhetoric and Professional Writing Option
sourceText:
ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

Humanities [HUM]

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

Social Sciences [SSCI]

Foreign Language, if necessary, or Elective

Arts [ARTS]

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Foreign Language, if necessary, or Electives

Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

ENGLISH 301 [WRTG]

Equity and Justice [EQJS]

HUMANITY Elective
HUMANTIY Electives: At least one from HUMANITY 101, 103, 302 [M], 303, 304, 335, 350, 410, or 450 is required.  Upper-division HUMANITY courses are not recommended for first-year students.

Electives

Diversity [DIVR]

ENGLISH 360

ENGLISH 362

ENGLISH 370, 371, 372, or 373

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

Complete University Writing Portfolio

ENGLISH 302 [M]

300-400-level Rhetoric / Professional Writing Electives
Rhetoric / Professional Writing Electives: Choose from CES 405, DTC 336, 354, 355 [M], 375 [M], 476, ENGLISH 308 [M], 358, 361, 363, 365, 401, 402 [M], 405, 458, 461 [M], and 495.

300-400-level Electives

Complete Senior Exit Survey

ENGLISH 460 [M] or 461 [M]
Prerequisite of ENGLISH 402 [M] or 403 [M] required for ENGLISH 461 [M].

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

A student may be admitted to the English – Rhetoric and Professional Writing Option upon making their intention known to the department.

Requirements in this degree include 18 credits of 300 - 400-level core courses, and 18 credits of approved electives. Students have the option to take an additional 6 credits  – with the approval of advisor – of any English or Humanities course at any level.
